LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussLance.description: A spacer-tech gauss lance. A series of electromagnetic coils catapult a single shot at hypervelocity, shredding armor and punching through any targets in its path. It is fired from the hip, utilizing an onboard computer to track and adjust to distant targets.
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussLance.label: gauss lance
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussLance.tools.0.label: barrel
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussMagnum.description: A spacer-tech gauss pistol. An array of coils accelerate sabot projectiles from a revolving drum, penetrating armor and piercing through targets in its path. It charges quicker than most coilguns at the cost of decreased damage.
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussMagnum.label: gauss magnum
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussMagnum.tools.0.label: grip
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussMagnum.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussRifle.description: A spacer-tech gauss rifle. A set of coils accelerate ferromagnetic sabots up to breakneck speeds, penetrating armor and piercing through multiple targets alike. These weapons are popular among frontline infantry fighting in mechanoid wars.
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussRifle.label: gauss rifle
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussRifle.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.VWE_Gun_GaussRifle.tools.1.label: barrel
